about: Held-out set for the story sequencer (KRI-1593). Each case lists clips in the order they were ADDED (c1 first), deliberately not the story order, and the precedence pairs a story order must satisfy, written by hand from what the clips show, never from a model's answer. Written with the prompt (same author) before any model run; the prompt has not been tuned against these cases, and must not be: a prompt change is judged on them, not fitted to them.
